messages.text: hi Sarah. Where does it ship from?
Happy to help. Which product are you asking about? We ship from US, Canadian and EU warehouses depending on the item and your address, so it depends on the unit.

The Magic M. 40T ships from our North American warehouse, with the plug and voltage matched to your delivery address (US, UK or EU).

It's a Batch 5 pre-sale unit, ships November 14. If you're in the EU, note the price excludes 21% import VAT, which customs or the carrier charges on delivery.

Where are you based? I can tell you what else applies.

Good news then, no import VAT or duties into Canada. Sales tax where it applies gets added at checkout, and shipping is calculated there from your address too.

Ships from the North American warehouse with a US-style plug, which is what you want in Ontario. November 14 for Batch 5.

Want me to run the numbers on what a 40T would stack at Ontario power rates?
what cost in cad after shipping and taxes added to the total?

The unit is $799 USD. All our prices are USD, so your card does the conversion at its own rate, and I can't quote you a firm CAD figure.

Shipping and Ontario sales tax both get calculated at checkout from your address, no import duty on top.

If you give me your postal code I'll build the cart and read you the exact shipping and tax it comes to.

Built it with your postal code. For (postcode hidden): $799 unit, $103.87 Ontario HST, so $902.87 USD before shipping. Shipping needs the street address, so it lands on the last checkout step.

Here's the cart if you want to finish it and see the shipping line: (order link hidden)

Nothing extra at the border.
